Definition: to separate; hence, to select, refuse, contract
BiblicalUsage: 1) to lay aside, reserve, withdraw, withhold; 1a) (Qal) to reserve, set apart, withhold; 1b) (Niphal) to be withdrawn; 1c) (Hiphil) to withdraw
